# n8n Packages

## Summary

Beta — breaking changes may still occur without major version bump.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/connect/n8n-api/instance-operations/n8n-packages.md

---

Beta — breaking changes may still occur without major version bump.

## Beta: Import an n8n package into a project

> \*\*Beta\*\* — breaking changes may still occur without major version bump.\
> \
> Imports Agent-only, workflow-only, mixed, and whole-project packages. The Agents module must be active for packages that contain Agents. Send the gzip-compressed tar archive (\`.n8np\`) as the multipart field \`package\`. Optional routing uses form fields \`projectId\` and \`folderId\` (omit or send empty for defaults). Every optional mode/policy field (credential, Agent, workflow, project, folder, data table, variable, and tag) takes its default when omitted; the one non-fixed default is \`folderConflictPolicy\`, which follows \`projectConflictPolicy\` on a project package. The required \`conflictPolicy\` field controls matches for both Agents and workflows. It replaces \`workflowConflictPolicy\`; the old field is rejected. \`idPolicy\` and \`publishingPolicy\` also apply to both kinds. They replace the workflow-specific and Agent-specific fields, which are rejected. Maximum upload size is \`N8N\_ENDPOINTS\_PAYLOAD\_SIZE\_MAX\` MB (default 16).\
> \
> The package must declare its manifest at \`manifest.json\` and include every file the manifest references.\
> \
> Credential and dependency references are resolved before writes. Request bindings support credential overrides only. Agent and workflow identities are matched automatically.\
> \
> Agent packages require \`agent:import\` and \`agent:read\`. Workflow packages require \`workflow:import\`. Mixed packages require both import grants. Planned Agent actions also require \`agent:create\`, \`agent:update\`, \`agent:publish\`, or \`agent:unpublish\`. Skipped Agents do not require write grants. Creating a project or instance skill requires \`skill:create\`, and saving a new version of one requires \`skill:update\`. When the import publishes a workflow, including a republish under \`preserve-published-state\`, the API key needs \`workflow:activate\`. When it unpublishes one, the key needs \`workflow:deactivate\`. Skipped workflows and workflows marked as archived in the package need neither publication scope. Archiving or restoring a matched workflow needs \`workflow:delete\`. Restoring and publishing a workflow requires both \`workflow:delete\` and \`workflow:activate\`. Destination-project permissions and dependency scopes still apply.\
> \
> The response contains Agent summaries in \`agents\`, source IDs in \`bindings.agents\`, and totals in \`counts.agents\`. Definition import and publication have separate outcomes. Check \`agents\[].publishing.state\` and \`workflows\[].publishing.state\` for publication results, including \`failed\`. A publication failure retains the imported definition and returns HTTP 200.\
> \
> Selected-Agent exports use this endpoint. Agent content is rejected by \`/import-selection\`, directory imports, and Promotions before writes.\
> \
> Example multipart fields: \`conflictPolicy=new-version\`, \`idPolicy=source\`, \`publishingPolicy=match-source\`, and \`bindings={"credentials":{"source-credential":"target-credential"}}\`.

## Beta: Import a selected subset of workflows from an n8n package

> \*\*Beta\*\* — breaking changes may still occur without major version bump.\
> \
> Imports a chosen subset of workflows from one source project of a gzip-compressed tar package (\`.n8np\`), instead of the whole package. Send the archive as the multipart field \`package\`. The import is \*\*additive\*\* (cherry-pick): it never removes a workflow the selection omits. It creates or updates only the workflows named in \`selectedWorkflowIds\`, and deletes only the destination workflows named in \`deletedWorkflowIds\`.\
> \
> \`selectedProjectId\` names the single source project the selection is scoped to (its id as it appears in the package). The selected workflows are written into the instance project whose id matches that source project, which is created if it does not yet exist; there is no separate target-project field. \`selectedWorkflowIds\` are source ids within that project; ids that belong to another project are dropped. \`deletedWorkflowIds\` are destination ids in the same project; an absent id is a tolerated no-op, and a delete needs the \`workflow:delete\` scope. A delete id must not match the destination id of a selected workflow, including when \`conflictPolicy=skip\`. This overlap returns a 409 before any writes.\
> \
> The package must be a project package (a workflow package is rejected with a 400). The cherry-pick conflict policies (folder, tag, and project) are fixed and are not accepted here; only \`conflictPolicy\`, \`idPolicy\`, and \`overwriteDeletionPolicy\` are configurable. Maximum upload size is \`N8N\_ENDPOINTS\_PAYLOAD\_SIZE\_MAX\` MB (default 16). The caller is authorised through the \`workflow:import\` scope. Packages that contain Agents are rejected before writes. Use the ordinary import endpoint for selected-Agent exports. \`conflictPolicy\` replaces \`workflowConflictPolicy\`, and \`idPolicy\` replaces \`workflowIdPolicy\`. The old fields are rejected. Publication remains fixed to \`match-source\`. When \`match-source\` publishes a selected workflow, the API key also needs \`workflow:activate\`. When it unpublishes one, the key needs \`workflow:deactivate\`. Archiving or restoring a matched workflow also needs \`workflow:delete\`. Restoring and publishing a workflow requires both \`workflow:delete\` and \`workflow:activate\`.

## Beta: Export agents, workflows, folders, or projects as an n8n package

> \*\*Beta\*\* — breaking changes may still occur without major version bump.\
> \
> Export agents, workflows, and folders, or whole projects, as a gzipped tar\
> archive (.n8np). Provide \`agentIds\`/\`workflowIds\`/\`folderIds\`, or \`projectIds\`.\
> Do not combine these two groups. Each exported folder includes its nested\
> folders. Whole projects include their agents when the agents module is enabled.\
> Explicit agent selections require the agents module. Empty projects export\
> project metadata only. \`versionPolicy\` selects the version for both agents and\
> workflows and defaults to \`latest\`. \`dependencyPolicy\` applies to both entity\
> types and defaults to \`fail\` when a required definition is absent from the\
> package. The response is streamed as \`application/gzip\` with a \`Content-Disposition\`\
> attachment header. Requires the n8n Packages feature to be licensed.\
> \
> API key scopes: \`agent:export\` is required for explicitly selected agents.\
> \`workflow:export\` is required for explicitly selected workflows or folders.\
> \`project:export\` is sufficient for whole-project exports, including their\
> agents and workflows. Included dependencies need no additional API key scope.\
> The caller's project permissions apply to all included entities. When\
> \`includeVariableValues\` is true (the default) and exported entities reference\
> variables, \`variable:list\` is also required. Exports that reference no variables\
> do not need it.\
> \
> Agent definitions include referenced skills, custom tools, and schedules.\
> Knowledge base files and runtime data are excluded.<br>
